content.value: Calculate the kinematic viscosity of an oil having s.g. of 0.84 which is used for lubrication between a square plate of size 0.8 m X 0.8 m and an inclined plane with angle of inclination 30° as shown in figure below. The weight of square plate is 300 N and it slides down the inclined plate with a uniform velocity of 0.3 m/s. the thickness of the oil film is 1.5 mm.
